name: Voxel Outgoing Radiance
definition: Calculates the diffuse outgoing radiance of a voxel `v` as seen from the side of face normal `n`, using cached irradiance. Emission is added omnidirectionally.
summary: Voxel Outgoing Radiance is a primary shading method that evaluates diffuse outgoing radiance by decoupling irradiance calculation from shading, using pre-computed irradiance caches for fast, face-dependent evaluation.
